d:
Aur mere chatoro, kaise ho aap, ghar par hi asani se market jaisi soft kaju katli banane ki recipe aaj share kar raha hu.
Sirf 10-12 minute mein aap ye mithai taiyaar kar sakte hain. Is kaju katli recipe mein hum sirf do main ingredients, kaju aur cheeni ka istemal karenge. Video mein maine step-by-step bataya hai ki kaise mixture ko sahi consistency tak pakana hai aur silver vark lagakar perfect mithai kaise banani hai.
